data.name: Arisha
data.gender_notes: Arisha is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic ʿarsh, 'throne', from the root ع-ر-ش (ʿ-r-sh). Its root is ع-ر-ش (ʿ-r-sh). A modern Muslim female name. Arisha is a Arabic name meaning “Throne; (also) a high rank”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arisha expresses “Throne; (also) a high rank”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic ʿarsh, 'throne', from the root ع-ر-ش (ʿ-r-sh).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arisha total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
